title: Theme conformance: run the matrix against a rendered theme (Services first)
detail:
LIVE-1998 shipped the ten checks as pure functions over data. This row collects the data: a Playwright spec (test/e2e/theme-conformance.spec.ts) that walks conformanceMatrix() against a themed site, measures block heights per type voice at 1440 and 390, toggles motion and reduced motion, hides each function in turn, resets, and times a dial change, then feeds every result to lib/theme/conformance.ts. It runs for each theme that declares dials in lib/themes/editor-schema2.json, Services first, and must be green on every theme PR. Needs the Services render (LIVE-1991 to 1993) and the renderer's root attributes.

Built as a spec that runs against a static render (CONFORMANCE_FIXTURE, from builder-roles-themes.render.tsx) or a themed page (CONFORMANCE_URL) and skips with neither. Covers contrast, type-voice height stability, reduced motion, reset and repaint budget on Services; ran green locally. Not covered: motion-additive, empty states, hidden functions, surface parity (need a live Space and the editor). Finding: the type dial changes no role-block title face in the Services render, so height stability passed without a voice to test. Wiring into CI against a preview Space is the follow-up row LIVE-2098.
